u-window: 'Titan would dive to 3,880' - 3,880 m is the wreck site depth; NTSB logs Titan's dives to the wreck at 3,840 m. Fix: 'The wreck lies at 3,880.' (or 'Titan dove to the Titanic, nearly four times deeper.')

w-sensors: 'On that dive' follows w-night (the battery dive, dive 73, June 2022), so it points at the wrong dive; NTSB ties the acoustic burst and strain jump to dive 80. f-ship: 'believed the radio link had dropped' - Titan's link was an acoustic system (NTSB 1.1, 1.3.5), not radio. Fix: 'they believed the acoustic link had dropped' or 'the link had dropped'.

r-response: follows r-culture ('The Coast Guard's board'), so 'the board said' attributes to the Coast Guard a finding that is the NTSB's (had OceanGate followed NVIC 05-93, assets likely standing by).
